intro: Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Let's find the colours! Let's go!
chorus: Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colours all around for me and you!
Look up high and look down low,
Paws and Claws, let's find a rainbow!
verses: Rory found something red, red, red,
A big red apple on the garden bed!
Point to something red with me!
Ziggy found something yellow and bright,
A yellow sunflower, what a sight!
Point to something yellow with me!
Waffles found something green, green, green,
The greenest leaf he's ever seen!
Point to something green with me!
Pebble found something blue, blue, blue,
The big blue sky and the ocean too!
Point to something blue with me!
bridge: A rainbow of colours for me and you!
Hooray for the rainbow, woo hoo hoo!
outro: Bye bye, friends! See you next time!
